answer: The strongest lever is simple: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because ripple only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, nectar is enforced in the ledger: The ledger rejects byte-identical submissions, forcing each clone to generate distinct work. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
